walk_fixes.reported: founder, walking items 2-8: "you claimed creators loading issue is working fine and reduced to one to one and half second ... pls check this not fixed."
walk_fixes.measured: GET /campaigns/:id/sets/:sid/pickable?tab=all against production: 18511 ms, 18301 ms, 18331 ms on three consecutive runs. Not a cold start. countOnly on the same endpoint returned in 1074 ms, and the list SQL itself EXPLAIN ANALYZEs at 1.8 ms — so the query was never the cost.
walk_fixes.cause: canBrandInviteMany was a sequential for-loop calling canBrandInviteCreator once per creator. Each call made about five separate database round trips — her invitation settings, her minimum commissions, her blocks, her agreed pitch, and brandFacts for THE SAME BRAND every time. 26 creators came to roughly 130 sequential trips. The 2026-09-16 fix removed a round trip between the phone and the server, which was real but was not this.
walk_fixes.mine: item 8 added the agreedPitchFor lookup (§7B) inside that loop without noticing the loop, making an existing defect about 20% worse.
walk_fixes.fix: the rule is now a pure function, decideInvite, with one copy of the logic that both the single and the list paths call. canBrandInviteMany prefetches every fact in five set-based queries and evaluates in memory. Measured against production: 7 round trips for 26 creators instead of ~130, and the list answer agrees with the single answer on 8 of 8 spot checks.
